channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: How an SUV carrying 27kg of mephedrone exposed a clandestine drug factory
item.description: A 27.2 kg mephedrone seizure led EAGLE Force to a clandestine laboratory in Maharashtra, exposing a network of chemical suppliers, equipment dealers and suspected drug manufacturers with links to Hyderabad

item.title: Allahabad High Court stays conviction of murder convict who wishes to contest 2027 U.P. polls
item.description: The court granted bail to the appellant, noting that he was a political figure and an active Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) worker before his conviction

item.title: Jaishankar welcomes UAE’s Foreign Minister Al Nahyan in Mumbai
item.description: PM Al Nahyan, who is also the UAE's Foreign Minister, will hold wide-ranging talks with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar on October 20

item.title: Naveen Patnaik questions Odisha government’s 'silence' on Andhra's poll notification for disputed Kotia villages
item.description: The decades-old dispute involves both Odisha and Andhra Pradesh claiming their right over 21 of the 28 villages of Kotia Gram Panchayat

item.title: Kuki group announces shutdown of key Manipur highway after attacks on villages
item.description: State government transfers Superintendent of Police in charge of Kamjong district

item.title: Kolkata Metro services disrupted for around 1 hour due to technical glitch
item.description: The disruption came at a time when large numbers of people use the Metro to visit Durga Puja pandals across the city on Maha Ashtami

item.title: CISF jawan nabs ‘suspicious’ man in escalator-stairs chase at Delhi Metro station
item.description: The CISF said in the post that it recovered an ‘unidentified semi-solid substance’, suspected to be gold, concealed in a stitched portion of the man's undergarment, kept in his bag

item.title: Watch: One killed, several injured in clashes in Manipur’s Thoubal
item.description: At least one person was killed and several others injured in clashes between two communities in Manipur’s Thoubal district on October 18, 2026. Houses and vehicles were set on fire in Khangabok and Sangaiyumpham, prompting prohibitory orders and the deployment of additional security forces.

item.title: Jaishankar meets Swift CEO in Delhi
item.description: Headquartered in Belgium, Swift is a globally inclusive organisation that serves institutions and individuals all over the world, according to its website

item.title: Kavitha accuses Congress government of neglecting farmers’ woes
item.description: She urged Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy to take immediate steps to protect farmers’ interests and alleged that no government official had visited the village to assess the crop damage

item.title: Revanth Reddy sets November-end deadline for Global Summit preparations
item.description: CM Revanth Reddy inspected the ongoing construction of the Young India Skills University and instructed officials to expedite the work to ensure their completion at least 15 days ahead of the stipulated deadline

item.title: Telangana plans 14-month foodgrain buffer to cover over 3 crore people amid El Niño threat
item.description: Telangana now has 9.64 lakh MT rice and another 18.39 lakh MT expected, taking estimated total to 28.03 lakh MT, sufficient for 11.7 months; wheat flour and other essentials under PDS being considered, says Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy

item.title: SKM joins agitation over SIR irregularities; movement to grow bigger: Actor Prakash Raj
item.description: Despite the cannons, despite the bulldozers, despite stopping them, they won the battle, and they just can’t keep quiet anymore, said Prakash Raj

item.title: DU panel flags irregularities in St Stephen's College faculty recruitment
item.description: The committee concluded that the college had made appointments in violation of the shortlisting criteria approved by the university's statutory bodies, according to its report

item.title: Row erupts over Daler Mehndi’s performance at Kunjapuri Fair in Uttarakhand
item.description: During the event, Cabinet Minister and Narendra Nagar MLA Subodh Uniyal took to the stage to express his displeasure with Daler Mehndi’s performance

item.title: Former Punjab MLA Simarjeet Bains sentenced to one year in defamation case
item.description: Therefore, the point of determination is answered in favour of the complainant... accused Simarjeet Singh Bains is hereby held guilty of committing the offence of defamation of the complainant, said the court

item.title: India’s agrivoltaic capacity is expected to be more than 5-gigawatts in next 3-4 years: MNRE Secretary
item.description: “It is difficult to estimate but it should be upwards of 5-gigawatts in the next 3-4 years. It depends on state’s enthusiasm, ability to quickly notify a feed-in tariff,” said Union Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Secretary Santosh Sarangi

item.title: Srinagar-bound bus attacked in Ludhiana's Khanna; no one injured
item.description: The incident took place on Sunday night when the bus was passing through Doraha in Khanna

item.title: RSS leader, W.B. Minister oppose attacks on book stalls set up by Left parties at Durga Puja pandals
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari continued to target the Left parties and said its supporters are trying to create anarchy in the country

item.title: Political mercury rises in Punjab ahead of Amit Shah’s visit
item.description: The AAP government has left no stone unturned in pushing Punjab into the pit of drugs, which caused many families to lose their children, said Amit Shah

item.title: Three killed in Manipur attack, bodies left outside CM’s bungalow
item.description: A fourth person died after he was shot during a musical programme on Sunday night, while three CRPF personnel were injured in a bomb blast

item.title: Left parties, BRS to stage a dharna in Khammam over alleged political bias in Indiramma housing allotments
Bihar council polls: 3 FIRs against JD(U) MLA Anant Singh, Jan Suraaj nominee Anuj Singh
item.description: Polling will be held from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. on October 23, with counting scheduled for October 27

item.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan launches upgraded agri welfare portal
item.description: The platform will serve as a single-window gateway to major government initiatives, including PM-KISAN, AgriStack and the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

item.title: Karnataka to bring all citizen services online, under Sakala
item.description: New guidelines mandate Kannada application forms, digital payments and SMS and WhatsApp updates on application status

item.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Three suspects detained in Kota; one was in touch with Bishnoi gang aide, says police
item.description: Three unidentified assailants opened fire at Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday (October 18, 2026) evening

item.title: El Nino effect: Prepare micro level contingency plans to avert drinking water, electricity shortages, says Telangana Chief Secretary
item.description: Special Chief Secretary to the government Jayesh Ranjan said that permission to drill new borewells in Hyderabad should not be granted for construction or other purposes

item.title: Delhi protest: CJP leaders’ judicial custody extended by two days
item.description: Along with other CJP workers, they displayed the national flag at the site and shouted slogans against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar before being detained and placed under preventive arrest

item.title: Shaan gets Dasara crowd singing and dancing
item.description: His repertoire included Yeno Onthara from the Kannada film Hudugaata, Jeena Jeena from Maanikya, songs from Om Shanti Om, Hum Tere Bin Ab Reh Nahi Sakte from Aashiqui 2, and Jab Se Tere Naina and Dil Kya Kare

item.title: Unconstitutional SIR must be stopped, all illegitimately deleted voters must be restored: Congress
item.description: Jairam Ramesh shared the screenshot of a media report which claimed that at least 100 voters from two polling booths in Delhi’s Okhla constituency were found to have been wrongly classified as absent

item.title: Over 2,000 attend TAUK’s handloom-themed Bathukamma, Dasara celebrations in London
item.description: Anil Kurmachalam, Telangana Association of United Kingdom founder, calls for promoting Telangana’s culture and handloom sector

item.title: ‘Chanda chori par chuppi chaayi’: Congress slams BJP on Ram temple donation theft case
item.description: Jairam Ramesh demanded that full accounting of offerings at the temple be made public, roles of all responsible persons investigated, and no official be spared accountability

item.title: More veggies from Telangana on plate: El Nino changes crop choices, farmers receive returns from harvest
item.description: Agriculture Secretary Surendra Mohan says they have tied up aggregators with farmers, will put in place cold storages

item.title: John Brittas seeks President’s intervention as JNU students’ hunger strike enters 17th day
item.description: John Brittas said the hunger strike, which began on October 3, followed the university administration's alleged failure to address the student community's genuine and longstanding concerns

item.title: Supreme Court stays execution of death sentence of convict in 2008 Ahmedabad serial blasts case
item.description: On July 7, the high court upheld the death sentences of 38 operatives of terror outfit Indian Mujahideen in the serial-bomb-blasts case

item.title: Sugarcane farmers suspend agitation, set new deadline
item.description: Sugarcane farmers from across the State who had launched Hubballi Chalk to press for their various demands temporarily suspended their week-long agitation

item.title: Keralam CM refuses to divulge details of individual who sponsored private flight, defends Ministers’ foreign trips, Shaji’s use of friend’s car
item.description: Satheesan says there was ‘nothing wrong with the trip as not a single penny was spent from the exchequer’

item.title: UDF convenor dares V.D. Satheesan reveal name of ‘anonymous benefactor’ who sponsored his chartered flight
item.description: Adoor Prakash told a television channel that V.D. Satheeshan had a moral obligation to clear the politically controversial ambiguity surrounding his ‘obstinate refusal’ to name the person or entity who sponsored the private chartered flight

item.title: Digital media threatening book culture, says Marulasiddappa at literary event
Tributes paid to Rajiv Gandhi recalling his communal peace rally at Charminar
item.description: The meeting is held every year since 1990 to commemorate former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi’s message of communal harmony and national integration from Charminar

item.title: Delhi SIR: Public audit in two booths finds over 100 voters wrongly marked absent, shifted, or dead
item.description: Voters residing at the same address for multiple decades express anger that they were marked ‘untraceable’, ‘absent’, and permanently shifted, and their only option is to enrol afresh using Form 6

item.title: POSH compliance in public sector banks: CIC remands RTI appeal for ‘fair hearing’
item.description: The applicant, Chayan Ghosh Chowdhury, cited the Supreme Court’s decision in Aureliano Fernandes vs State of Goa case and claimed that banks had failed to constitute Internal Committees as required under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013

item.title: The Howdah Bearers | Mysuru's Dasara elephants
item.description: Kings stopped riding it in 1969. The elephants never stopped carrying it. This year, Mysuru has picked the next elephant.

item.title: Delhi High Court permits 16-year-old rape survivor to terminate 31-week pregnancy
item.description: Under the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, the procedure can be done till 20 weeks of gestation period in ordinary cases and 24 weeks in certain categories such as rape survivors

item.title: Neha Bora moves Delhi High Court against peace bond notice
item.description: AISA said Neha Bora’s petition seeks an immediate stay and withdrawal of the notice, and argues that the notice is prima facie ambiguous and factually incorrect

item.title: Three rescued orangutans in Odisha suffering from anaemia: Officials
item.description: A comprehensive health check-up of the five primates, including X-rays and blood tests, was carried out after one of the juvenile orangutans developed fever; No major breakthrough in the probe so far

item.title: SC upholds cancellation of patta over Tamil Nadu water body, orders alternative site for 20 flat owners
item.description: A Bench of Justices S.V.N. Bhatti and N.V. Anjaria directed the Tamil Nadu government to allot a suitable site to the 20 flat owners within six months before demolishing their apartments

item.title: Prior nod to probe bribe demand by police personnel not needed under anti-graft law: Supreme Court
item.description: The significant observation was made by a Bench of Justices S.V.N. Bhatti and N.V. Anjaria in its judgment delivered on October 16

item.title: MEA rejects OIC’s ‘anti-India’ references, accuses Pakistan of orchestrating them
item.description: The MEA said that the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are integral and inalienable parts of India, and “politically motivated propaganda” cannot alter that reality

item.title: Kerala High Court directs release of ₹9.73 crore for 225 victim compensation claims
item.description: The court also directed the secretaries of the respective District Legal Services Authorities to collect all required documents from victims while their cases were pending before the court to avoid delays in processing and disbursing compensation

item.title: Peaceful protest is fundamental right, but protesters’ credentials must be weighed: Bombay HC
item.description: The Bombay High Court directed the Maharashtra government to respond to petitions alleging illegal detention of protesters during the anti-CEC demonstrations, while cautioning that “criminals should not participate” under the guise of civilians

item.title: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi, former CM Jagadish Shettar seek time from sugarcane farmers of Karnataka at late night meeting in Hubballi
item.description: Farmers to decide next course of action after consultations on October 19

item.title: NGT halts tree felling for Hebbal Short Tunnel Project in Bengaluru
item.description: The tribunal has scheduled the next hearing for December 15

item.title: Anti-drug activist murder: Diljit Dosanjh says Jhota's family should get justice
item.description: Known for raising his voice against the illegal sale of addictive substances at chemist shops, Parvinder Singh Jhota was shot in broad daylight inside a medical store in a busy marketplace in Mansa on October 13

item.title: We're seeking development in all domains, air, sea to AI: Vice-chief of Naval Staff
item.description: Vice Admiral Ajay Kochhar also referred to the Navy's Operation Urja Suraksha, which has helped in safely escorting many ships to Indian shores, amid attacks in critical sea lanes

item.title: Anbumani Ramadoss discharged from hospital after undergoing elective knee procedure
item.description: As per a medical bulletin, Dr. Ramadoss underwent the procedure at Chennai’s Apollo Hospitals, Greams Road

item.title: Hyderabad airport regains X account access after cryptocurrency promotion posts by hackers
item.description: At around 1.30 a.m., the airport’s X handle, ‘@RGIAHyd’, published posts promoting ‘StonkFun Season 1’, an eligibility checker linked to the Stonk App and the Solana cryptocurrency ecosystem.

item.title: Thousands witness Cauvery Theerthodbhava at Talacauvery
Indian air ambulance makes emergency landing in Bangladesh; patient dies
item.description: The air ambulance, flying from Agartala to Kolkata, made an emergency landing in Dhaka after a mid-air technical fault; the 56-year-old patient later died at a city hospital

item.title: Foreign object on runway forces flight to abort landing at Bengaluru airport
item.description: The officials did not specify the nature of the foreign object sighted on the runway
